tools.name: about_whichpost
tools.description: What WhichPost does, who it is for and who it isn't for, what a team gets from a report, and where to start. Public information; needs no sign-in.

tools.name: how_it_works
tools.description: How WhichPost works in plain language: the three setup steps, the revenue sources it connects to (Stripe, RevenueCat, Superwall), the post platforms it reads (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, X), how each creator gets a decision, and what a product needs for a clear answer. Public information; nee

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: WhichPost's plans and prices in US dollars (Creator Audit, Monitoring, Studio, Agency), what each is for, and current offers. Public information; needs no sign-in.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers to common questions: Stripe key safety, what is read, setup, how a post is credited without a link, accuracy and ranges, what a product needs, promo codes, and what happens when the data isn't enough. Optionally one topic. Public information; needs no sign-in.

tools.name: privacy_and_security
tools.description: How WhichPost handles data: read-only keys, what is read and kept, no device or viewer tracking, where data is processed, and what a connected assistant can and can never see. Public information; needs no sign-in.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: A quick, fixed questionnaire: from the revenue source, creators per month, new sign-ups or installs a day and a few yes/no answers, it says whether WhichPost is a good fit now, which plan suits, and the next step. The same answers always give the same result; answers are not stored. Needs no sign-in

tools.name: get_sample_report
tools.description: A labelled sample report built from simulated data, so anyone can see what WhichPost answers before connecting their own data: paying users with their likely range, cost per paying user, and a decision per creator. Needs no sign-in. The numbers are simulated and are not anyone's results.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_faq · Public sink: how_it_works, get_faq.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_faq · Public sink: how_it_works, get_faq

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
